high_level_description: This image captures a stunning natural phenomenon set against the backdrop of a starry night sky. The main focus is a large, dramatic cloud formation that dominates the lower portion of the frame. The cloud appears to be illuminated from below, giving it a warm, golden hue that contrasts beautifully with the cool tones of the surrounding sky. Above the cloud, there is a mesmerizing display of an ice halo, also known as a 22-degree halo or a glory. This optical effect is caused by the refraction of light through ice crystals in the atmosphere.
